ambiguities_or_notes: исполнил в точности все назначенное is rendered ‘carried out exactly everything I had planned,’ making the implied self-planning relation explicit without changing its substance.
хозяйство is rendered ‘estate management’ in the schedule; the activity sense is retained rather than treating it as a physical place.
писать методу музыки is rendered ‘write the music method’; the shorthand is not silently expanded into the formal title of Tolstoy's related music-method text.
The source's terse schedule syntax and 4 1/2 fraction markup are preserved.
